title: Why some banks won't open your account under $10M
description: A bank that turns away million-dollar depositors because a million dollars isn't the threshold. Private banking exists for a tier of wealth most people never see — and the fee for admission is silence, not cash.

scenes.narration: The money was never really the product. The access was.
